verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs describe a built-in capability to track project performance with every deployment and to understand the behavior of visitors to the site or app, which covers both halves of the story. The evidence is a single high-level summary line, though. Missing for 10: detail on specific performance metrics and visitor analytics features (dashboards, retention, real-user vs. server-side data), plan/pricing scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics

citations.quote: Track your project's performance with every deployment and understand your Netlify team's behavior and the behavior of visitors to your site or app.
